mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.3% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.3%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.45 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1450.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 101.0 index level signals weakening real economic activity and declining corporate earnings momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 101.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based demand surge that strengthens corporate revenue outlooks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.2% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals entrenched inflationary expectations that delay rate cuts and sustain high discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.2 and FEDFUNDS >= 3.5%, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payroll growth signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation risks, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 158000, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth above 2.0% annualized, combined with stable inflation, signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
